title: Use official typhoon information
objective: Teach the learner to use official information without pretending CALM has live data.
ordered_actions: Check the authenticated PAGASA, school, LGU, barangay, teacher, or guardian update.
Follow the instruction for the learner's actual location.
Ask a responsible adult when the message is unclear.
prohibited_actions: Do not trust or forward an unverified post or message.
Do not ask the static corpus for the current signal.
adult_handoff: A teacher, guardian, or local authority interprets the current warning and route.
rationale: The static knowledge base cannot verify a live storm signal or evacuation order.
safe_default: Ask the teacher or guardian for the authenticated current update.

en-PH.instruction: Check PAGASA or the verified school, LGU, barangay, teacher, or guardian message. Ask an adult if it is unclear.

fil-PH.instruction: Tingnan ang PAGASA o beripikadong mensahe ng paaralan, LGU, barangay, guro, o tagapag-alaga. Magtanong kung hindi malinaw.

taglish-PH.instruction: Check PAGASA or the verified school, LGU, barangay, teacher, or guardian message. Ask an adult kung unclear.

title: Know the home plan and child-safe go-bag items
objective: Give the learner a safe preparation role without adult-controlled items.
ordered_actions: Know the family route and meeting place.
With a guardian check water, ready-to-eat food, clothing, flashlight, whistle, radio, rain gear, blanket, hygiene items, and a comfort item.
Keep the bag accessible without blocking an exit.
prohibited_actions: Do not handle matches, lighters, candles, knives, medicine, cash, legal records, fuel, or chemicals.
Do not retrieve the bag if evacuation has started or the route is unsafe.
adult_handoff: The guardian controls medicine, documents, money, hazardous items, and the decision to take the bag.
rationale: Preparation can be age-appropriate only when custody and evacuation timing are explicit.
safe_default: Prepare only with a guardian and never delay evacuation for the bag.

en-PH.short: Prepare the go-bag with a guardian.
en-PH.instruction: Check child-safe supplies and the family route. Never handle hazardous items or delay evacuation to get the bag.

fil-PH.short: Ihanda ang go-bag kasama ang tagapag-alaga.
fil-PH.instruction: Suriin ang ligtas na supplies at ruta ng pamilya. Huwag humawak ng delikadong gamit o maantala ang paglikas para kunin ang bag.

taglish-PH.short: Prepare the go-bag with a guardian.
taglish-PH.instruction: Check child-safe supplies and the family route. Never handle hazardous items or delay evacuation para kunin ang bag.

title: Know the school typhoon plan
objective: Prepare the learner to recognize the local school warning and approved movement plan.
ordered_actions: Learn the school warning or teacher cue.
Know the approved safe room, exit route, and reunification or assembly point.
Join drills and ask questions before an emergency.
prohibited_actions: Do not invent a route from a national document.
Do not treat a school ground-marker color as a PAGASA warning color.
adult_handoff: The school and local DRRMO approve the route, rooms, cues, and reunification plan.
rationale: DepEd policy requires school-specific early warning, mapping, drills, and reunification.
safe_default: Ask the teacher for the school's approved plan.

en-PH.short: Know your school's warning and route.
en-PH.instruction: Learn the approved safe room, exit, and reunification point from your teacher and practise the drill.

fil-PH.short: Alamin ang babala at ruta ng paaralan.
fil-PH.instruction: Alamin sa guro ang itinakdang safe room, labasan, at reunification point at sanayin ang drill.

taglish-PH.short: Know your school's warning and route.
taglish-PH.instruction: Learn the approved safe room, exit, and reunification point from your teacher, then practise the drill.

title: Leave outdoor danger before typhoon conditions worsen
objective: Move the learner into an approved shelter before wind rain or flooding blocks the route.
ordered_actions: Stop outdoor play or travel.
Follow the responsible adult and approved route.
Enter the approved shelter before conditions worsen.
prohibited_actions: Do not stay to watch the storm.
Do not take a shortcut near a river, coast, tree, post, or flood-prone area.
adult_handoff: A responsible adult selects the local safe route and shelter.
rationale: Early movement reduces exposure to rising water, windborne objects, and falling hazards.
safe_default: Follow the responsible adult to the approved shelter.

en-PH.short: Go to the approved shelter with an adult.
en-PH.instruction: Stop outdoor activity and use the approved route before wind, rain, or floodwater gets worse.

fil-PH.short: Pumunta sa itinakdang silungan kasama ang nakatatanda.
fil-PH.instruction: Itigil ang gawain sa labas at sundin ang tamang ruta bago lumakas ang hangin, ulan, o baha.

taglish-PH.short: Go to the approved shelter with an adult.
taglish-PH.instruction: Stop outdoor activity and use the approved route bago lumakas ang wind, rain, o floodwater.

title: Evacuate when an authenticated order is given
objective: Make an official evacuation order override generic shelter advice.
ordered_actions: Stay with the responsible adult or class.
Use the approved evacuation route.
Go directly to the assigned evacuation or assembly area.
prohibited_actions: Do not wait for conditions to get worse.
Do not retrieve belongings if that delays evacuation.
Do not enter floodwater or use an unapproved route.
adult_handoff: The authority, school, or guardian controls the order and route.
rationale: An authenticated evacuation order must deterministically supersede a normal stay-inside card.
safe_default: Follow the responsible adult on the approved route.

en-PH.short: Evacuate now with your adult or class.
en-PH.instruction: Use the approved route and go straight to the assigned safe area. Leave belongings if they would delay you.

fil-PH.short: Lumikas ngayon kasama ang nakatatanda o klase.
fil-PH.instruction: Sundin ang tamang ruta at dumiretso sa itinakdang ligtas na lugar. Iwan ang gamit kung makaaantala ito.

taglish-PH.short: Evacuate now with your adult or class.
taglish-PH.instruction: Use the approved route and go straight to the assigned safe area. Leave belongings kung makaka-delay.

title: Shelter away from windows during a typhoon
objective: Keep the learner in an approved indoor area away from glass when no evacuation order is active.
ordered_actions: Stay calm in the approved safe area.
Keep away from windows and glass.
Listen to the teacher, guardian, or authenticated update.
prohibited_actions: Do not go outside to watch or record the storm.
Do not stand near windows.
Do not ignore a later evacuation order.
adult_handoff: A teacher, guardian, or authority decides whether sheltering continues.
rationale: Shelter guidance is valid only while the location remains approved and no evacuation order supersedes it.
safe_default: Stay in the approved area away from windows.

en-PH.short: Stay in the safe area away from windows.
en-PH.instruction: Remain calm and listen to your teacher, guardian, or verified update. Follow an evacuation order if one is given.

fil-PH.short: Manatili sa ligtas na lugar na malayo sa bintana.
fil-PH.instruction: Maging mahinahon at makinig sa guro, tagapag-alaga, o beripikadong abiso. Sumunod kung may utos na lumikas.

taglish-PH.short: Stay in the safe area away from windows.
taglish-PH.instruction: Remain calm and listen to your teacher, guardian, or verified update. Follow the evacuation order kung meron.

title: Follow the teacher during school typhoon response
objective: Keep the learner with the class under the localized school plan.
ordered_actions: Listen to the teacher.
Move or shelter with the class as directed.
Stay at the assigned safe area for headcount.
prohibited_actions: Do not leave the class, use a shortcut, or go home alone.
Do not touch flood markers, electrical equipment, or school utilities.
adult_handoff: School staff implement the DepEd and local DRRMO plan.
rationale: National policy defines school responsibilities but the actual movement plan is local.
safe_default: Stay with the teacher and class.

en-PH.short: Stay with your teacher and class.
en-PH.instruction: Shelter or move only as your teacher directs, then remain at the assigned safe area for headcount.

fil-PH.short: Manatili kasama ang guro at klase.
fil-PH.instruction: Sumilong o lumipat ayon lamang sa utos ng guro, saka manatili sa itinakdang safe area para sa bilang.

taglish-PH.short: Stay with your teacher and class.
taglish-PH.instruction: Shelter or move only as your teacher directs, then stay sa assigned safe area for headcount.

title: Reach approved shelter from outdoors
objective: Move the learner off an exposed outdoor route without crossing flood or overhead hazards.
ordered_actions: Stay with the responsible adult.
Use only the trusted route to the approved sturdy shelter.
Keep away from rivers, shores, trees, posts, signs, power lines, and floodwater.
prohibited_actions: Do not shelter under a tree, light structure, waiting shed, or tent unless the scenario authority specifically approves it.
Do not cross floodwater.
adult_handoff: A local authority or responsible adult selects the route and shelter.
rationale: Outdoor typhoon safety depends on the trusted local route and shelter state.
safe_default: Stay with the adult and use only the trusted route.

en-PH.short: Stay with the adult and use the approved shelter route.
en-PH.instruction: Keep away from floodwater, rivers, shores, trees, posts, signs, and power lines.

fil-PH.short: Manatili sa nakatatanda at sundin ang tamang ruta sa silungan.
fil-PH.instruction: Lumayo sa baha, ilog, dalampasigan, puno, poste, karatula, at linya ng kuryente.

taglish-PH.short: Stay with the adult and use the approved shelter route.
taglish-PH.instruction: Keep away from floodwater, rivers, shores, trees, posts, signs, at power lines.

review_notes: Exact route and shelter require deployment-specific school or local DRRMO approval.

title: Do not enter floodwater
objective: Prevent entry into floodwater at any depth.
ordered_actions: Stop before the water.
Move back to the approved dry safe area.
Tell a teacher, guardian, or responder that the route is flooded.
Wait for a new approved route.
prohibited_actions: Do not walk, wade, swim, play, boat, or drive through floodwater.
Do not use water depth as proof that crossing is safe.
adult_handoff: A local authority or responder selects a safe route or rescue.
rationale: Depth, current, contamination, holes, debris, and electricity may be hidden.
safe_default: Stay out of the water and report the blocked route.

en-PH.instruction: Move back to the approved dry safe area, tell an adult the route is flooded, and wait for a new route.

fil-PH.instruction: Bumalik sa itinakdang tuyong ligtas na lugar, sabihin sa nakatatanda na baha ang ruta, at maghintay ng bagong daan.

taglish-PH.instruction: Move back to the approved dry safe area, tell an adult na flooded ang route, at wait for a new route.

title: Keep away from fallen wires and wet electricity
objective: Keep the learner away from an electrical hazard.
ordered_actions: Stop and keep well away.
Warn nearby people without approaching the hazard.
Tell a teacher, guardian, or responder.
prohibited_actions: Do not touch a wire, post, outlet, appliance, water near electricity, breaker, or switch.
Do not try to move the hazard.
adult_handoff: A trained adult, utility worker, or responder isolates the hazard.
rationale: Water and fallen electrical equipment may be energized even when they look harmless.
safe_default: Keep away and alert an adult.

en-PH.short: Keep away from the wire or wet electrical item.
en-PH.instruction: Do not touch it or nearby water. Warn others and tell an adult or responder.

fil-PH.short: Lumayo sa kable o basang gamit na de-kuryente.
fil-PH.instruction: Huwag hawakan ito o ang kalapit na tubig. Magbabala sa iba at magsabi sa nakatatanda o responder.

taglish-PH.short: Keep away from the wire or wet electrical item.
taglish-PH.instruction: Do not touch it or nearby water. Warn others and tell an adult or responder.

title: Move higher when rising water blocks evacuation
objective: Move the learner away from rising water without entering it.
ordered_actions: Stay with the responsible adult or class.
Use the dry approved route to the higher safe area.
Signal or communicate your location.
Wait for responder instructions.
prohibited_actions: Do not enter the water.
Do not climb an unapproved roof, tree, or unstable object.
Do not leave the group.
adult_handoff: Responders or the local authority direct rescue or further movement.
rationale: The action is allowed only when trusted VR state confirms a dry approved route to higher shelter.
safe_default: Stay out of the water and use only the approved dry route with an adult.

en-PH.short: Use the approved dry route to higher safety.
en-PH.instruction: Stay with the adult or class, do not enter the water, and signal your location.

fil-PH.short: Gamitin ang tuyong tamang ruta papunta sa mas mataas na ligtas na lugar.
fil-PH.instruction: Manatili sa nakatatanda o klase, huwag lumusong sa tubig, at ipaalam ang inyong lokasyon.

taglish-PH.short: Use the approved dry route to higher safety.
taglish-PH.instruction: Stay with the adult or class, do not enter the water, at signal your location.

title: Wait for official clearance after a typhoon
objective: Prevent movement based only on quieter weather.
ordered_actions: Remain in the approved safe area.
Listen for authenticated authority, teacher, or guardian clearance.
Move only when the approved route is confirmed.
prohibited_actions: Do not go outside or return home just because the weather looks calmer.
Do not explore the affected area.
adult_handoff: The authority, school, or guardian confirms clearance and route.
rationale: Flooding, wind, structural damage, and electrical hazards can remain after the storm weakens.

en-PH.instruction: Stay in the approved safe area until an authority, teacher, or guardian confirms the route is safe.

fil-PH.instruction: Manatili sa itinakdang ligtas na lugar hanggang kumpirmahin ng kinauukulan, guro, o tagapag-alaga na ligtas ang ruta.

taglish-PH.instruction: Stay sa approved safe area until an authority, teacher, or guardian confirms na safe ang route.

title: Avoid damaged areas after a typhoon
objective: Keep the learner away from post-storm structural and electrical hazards.
ordered_actions: Keep your distance.
Tell a teacher, guardian, or responder what and where the hazard is.
Use only the cleared route.
prohibited_actions: Do not touch fallen trees, damaged buildings, debris, wires, outlets, or standing water.
Do not inspect or repair damage.
adult_handoff: Responders and qualified adults inspect and repair hazards.
rationale: Post-storm hazards may collapse, cut, contaminate, or electrocute.
safe_default: Keep away and report the hazard.

en-PH.instruction: Report the hazard to an adult or responder and use only a cleared route.

fil-PH.instruction: Ireport ang panganib sa nakatatanda o responder at gumamit lamang ng rutang pinayagan na.

taglish-PH.instruction: Report the hazard to an adult or responder and use only a cleared route.

title: Stay with the class for reunification
objective: Keep the learner accounted for until the school completes its approved release process.
ordered_actions: Stay with the class or assigned group.
Answer headcount.
Follow the teacher to the approved reunification point.
Leave only through the approved release process.
prohibited_actions: Do not leave school alone or meet an unverified person.
Do not go back to a damaged room for belongings.
adult_handoff: School staff manage headcount and authorized reunification.
rationale: DepEd policy treats learner tracking and reunification as school responsibilities.
safe_default: Stay with the assigned teacher or group.

en-PH.short: Stay with your class for reunification.
en-PH.instruction: Answer headcount and leave only through the school's approved release process.

fil-PH.short: Manatili sa klase para sa reunification.
fil-PH.instruction: Sumagot sa bilang at umalis lamang sa tamang release process ng paaralan.

taglish-PH.short: Stay with your class for reunification.
taglish-PH.instruction: Answer headcount and leave only through the school's approved release process.

title: Tell a guardian how you feel
objective: Support an age-appropriate emotional check-in without diagnosis.
ordered_actions: Tell a trusted adult what you are feeling.
Ask questions about what happens next.
Stay with the family in the safe area.
prohibited_actions: Do not hide pain, fear, or an injury.
Do not treat CALM as a counsellor or medical diagnosis.
adult_handoff: A guardian, teacher, counsellor, or health professional provides support when needed.
rationale: UNICEF emphasizes children's mental and emotional safety after disasters.
safe_default: Talk to a trusted adult and stay with the family.

en-PH.short: Tell a trusted adult how you feel.
en-PH.instruction: It is okay to feel worried. Ask what happens next and stay with your family in the safe area.

fil-PH.short: Sabihin sa pinagkakatiwalaang nakatatanda ang nararamdaman mo.
fil-PH.instruction: Ayos lang ang mag-alala. Magtanong kung ano ang susunod at manatili sa pamilya sa ligtas na lugar.

taglish-PH.short: Tell a trusted adult how you feel.
taglish-PH.instruction: Okay lang to feel worried. Ask what happens next and stay with your family sa safe area.

title: Remain sheltered after outdoor typhoon exposure
objective: Keep the learner at the approved shelter until the route is cleared.
ordered_actions: Stay with the responsible adult.
Remain inside the approved shelter.
Wait for clearance and a confirmed route.
prohibited_actions: Do not continue the trip, explore, or return outside without clearance.
Do not cross water or debris.
adult_handoff: The local authority or responsible adult confirms movement.
rationale: A quieter storm does not prove outdoor routes are safe.
safe_default: Remain sheltered with the responsible adult.

en-PH.instruction: Remain with the responsible adult until an authority confirms the outdoor route is safe.

fil-PH.instruction: Manatili kasama ang nakatatanda hanggang kumpirmahin ng kinauukulan na ligtas ang ruta sa labas.

taglish-PH.instruction: Remain with the responsible adult until an authority confirms na safe ang outdoor route.

title: Leave utilities cleanup and repair to adults
objective: Prevent adult and professional recovery tasks from becoming learner instructions.
ordered_actions: Step away from the damaged or wet area.
Tell a teacher, guardian, or responder what you noticed.
Wait in the approved safe area.
prohibited_actions: Do not switch electricity on or off.
Do not touch gas, outlets, appliances, wires, floodwater, debris, tools, roofs, trees, or damaged structures.
Do not clean contaminated water or food.
adult_handoff: Qualified adults and professionals inspect, isolate, clean, and repair.
rationale: Source recovery lists contain tasks that are hazardous for children.
safe_default: Step away and report the hazard.

en-PH.short: Step away and leave repair to adults.
en-PH.instruction: Report the damaged, wet, or dirty area and do not touch utilities, tools, debris, or floodwater.

fil-PH.short: Lumayo at ipaubaya sa nakatatanda ang pagkukumpuni.
fil-PH.instruction: Ireport ang sira, basa, o maruming lugar at huwag hawakan ang utilities, tools, debris, o baha.

taglish-PH.short: Step away and leave repair to adults.
taglish-PH.instruction: Report the damaged, wet, or dirty area and do not touch utilities, tools, debris, or floodwater.
